customer: Hello, I'm a grad student in Dunmore and I'm hoping to sell my coupe to Northwind Auto. I got married last year, so the name on the title is my maiden name while my driver's license shows my married name. Could you tell me what I'd need to bring so this doesn't cause a problem?
agent: Congratulations, and thanks for checking ahead! As our article "The name on the title doesn't match my ID" explains, please bring the document that shows the change, in your case your marriage certificate. You'll also sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at your appointment. If your ex-spouse were ever listed on a title, we'd point you to "My ex is still on the title," but for a marriage name change, the certificate and affidavit are what you'll need.
